root_cause: The v1 factorization uses binary REL_HIGH and ENT_LOW heads. Those targets collapse the registered middle ambiguity bands together with decisive negative bands. Specifically, relation<2 merges relation<=1 (decisive REJECT coordinate) with 1<relation<2 (potential CANNOT_CHECK coordinate), and entity>1 merges entity>=2 (decisive REJECT coordinate) with 1<entity<2 (potential CANNOT_CHECK coordinate). The downstream decision layer therefore cannot recover the tri-state gold partition even with a perfect binary classifier unless confidence happens to encode the hidden within-negative ordering. No calibrated threshold pair satisfied the preregistered safety/retention constraints.
